name: 45369-ngramdecode-qwen306b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 -- one eighth of one a3 node (--gres=gpu:1), driver 570.195.03.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine on one node. No router, no external cache tier, no KV connector, no offloading.
architecture: dense causal decoder (Qwen3ForCausalLM), bf16, public and ungated: 28 layers, hidden 1024, 16 query heads and 8 KV heads at head_dim 128, intermediate 3072, vocab 151936, ~0.60e9 parameters, ~1.2 GB of weights.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 2000 requests with a 3600 s safety cap, static seed 45369.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`, 1024 prompt tokens in and exactly 1024 tokens out per request (min == max on both ends), single turn, text only. Sampling is declared in `scenario.json`: temperature 0.8, no top-k, no top-p, no penalties -- a strictly positive temperature is required on every request.
purpose: A compact Qwen3 creative-writing assistant streaming 1024-token replies from page-length prompts for 64 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# The model, the speculative-decoding configuration and the topology this setup serves, in the
# form `vllm serve --config` takes. Nothing here was searched for and no knob below is tunable.

# Part of the declaration rather than a convenience: the checkpoint is not substitutable.
model: Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B

# N-gram (prompt-lookup) drafting: no draft model and no second set of weights. k = 16 proposals
# per running request per step, drafted from a repeat of at least 2 and at most 4 tokens.
# MUST STAY ONE PHYSICAL LINE, and a YAML mapping rather than a JSON string: this file is read
# line by line with indented lines skipped, so re-flowing the mapping into a block drops the key
# and the engine starts without speculative decoding at rc=0.
speculative-config: {"method": "ngram", "num_speculative_tokens": 16, "prompt_lookup_min": 2, "prompt_lookup_max": 4}

# Neutral request defaults. The default is `auto`, which reads the checkpoint's own
# generation_config.json -- and this one ships `temperature 0.6, top_k 20, top_p 0.95`, which the
# declared sampling (temperature only) does not want folded back into the request defaults.
generation-config: vllm

tensor-parallel-size: 1

# The checkpoint's own torch_dtype, written down so a default cannot drift it.
dtype: bfloat16

# Trimmed from the checkpoint's own 40960 to just above what the workload uses: 1024 prompt +
# 1024 output + the speculative tail = 2049 at the peak.
max-model-len: 4096

# Pinned, not a restated default: a decode step at this operating point puts 64 x (1 + 16) = 1088
# tokens into the batch and a 1024-token prefill has to fit beside it.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192

# This engine's own default, written down so it cannot drift. Not binding at the declared 64.
max-num-seqs: 128

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

# Off: every synthetic prompt in this workload is distinct, so there is nothing across requests to
# reuse and every request does the whole of its own prompt.
enable-prefix-caching: false
